summary.executive_summary: This Internship Agreement outlines the terms for Mohan Chandra S S to serve as an SDE Intern at Neutrinos Software Services Pvt Ltd for a 10-week period starting March 2, 2026. The agreement specifies a part-time commitment of 15 hours per week based in Bangalore, with reporting duties to the Technical Lead. It includes standard provisions regarding confidentiality, code of conduct, and a mutual termination notice period of 7 days. The contract is governed by the company's internal policies and requires adherence to information security standards.
key_points: Internship duration is 10 weeks, commencing on 02-Mar-2026.
Part-time commitment of 15 hours per week.
Reporting structure is under the Technical Lead in the Professional Services department.
Mutual termination requires 7 days of written notice.
Employee must comply with ISO 27001 and SOC 2-aligned confidentiality and non-disclosure policies.
Intern is expected to participate in training and follow defined coding standards.
favorable_clauses: The 7-day mutual termination notice period provides flexibility for both the intern and the employer to end the arrangement without excessive burden.
recommended_actions: Clarify if the internship is paid or unpaid, as compensation details are currently missing.
Request a formal Intellectual Property assignment clause to ensure clarity on ownership of work created during the internship.
Inquire about the specific governing law and dispute resolution mechanism, as these are currently absent from the agreement.
Verify if the intern is entitled to any benefits or expense reimbursements under local Indian labor laws.
Ensure the intern receives a copy of the specific 'Neutrinos confidentiality and Non-disclosure agreement' referenced in the contract to review before signing.
